pins.definition: Accurate, true, or free from error.
Free from error; matching the facts.
Free from error; matching the facts or truth.

situation: A smiling schoolgirl holds up her finished jigsaw puzzle, where the last piece sits perfectly in place and all the pieces fit together into a picture of a sunny meadow; her teacher beside her gives a big thumbs-up with the hand clearly drawn. Both are delighted that everything is correct.
subject: everything fits correctly, a thumbs-up for a finished puzzle

Both are delighted that everything is correct. detailed 16-bit pixel art, a rich limited palette with careful dithering, chunky readable sprites in a densely furnished scene, side-lit. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
